scope: Isolated original BEST BREAKOUT/FIB sleeve; EMA4h and cross-bot coordinator excluded, so not a full production portfolio replay.
data_status: These dates were used in prior research. Chronological validation is NOT a pristine unseen holdout. Recent October losses motivated variants. Future paper evaluation required.
selection: No parameter sweep or combined variant. Compare individual hypotheses at unchanged risk. Candidate requires positive validation net, >=30 closed trades, PF>=1.1, drawdown no worse than baseline and positive net under doubled slippage. Passing is eligibility for shadow paper, not production replacement.
execution: 5m OHLC replay: signal on closed bars, entry next open, stop first on ambiguous bars, gap stop at open, break-even update on close effective next bar; no time exit. Deterministic symbol priority matches configured list, not live asynchronous ordering.
limitations: short financing omitted as in existing paper model
no database durability claim from offline simulation
no historical regime labels inferred from future prices
